mechanism: Batch all geometrically certified pending second measurements at the current point; cached once; each channel charged separately.
development: Existing 52 configurations, both rounding models. No parameter sweep.
selection: Require all complete and audited. Compare all-case mean, p95, worst paired regression and known cluster; promote only supported lower time. Prefer no empty-origin fallback if batch resolves its motivating failure. Lock before fresh validation. If candidate fails, retain REF.
limits: No official/formal execution; batch bound 19 is channel count bound, not tuned threshold; no hidden truth used.
